how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_013.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

Receive a mental warning when entities with hostile intent enter your proximity.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dark_cube.des: Create a cube of darkness that slows movement and deals constant damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dark_eight_pa: Launch up to eight devastating aura blasts at foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness.desc: Call on your spirit to reduce the enemy's vision in a wide area.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness_atta: Ignore weaker darkness damage or reduce the damage of stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness_cann: Shoot a long beam which deals massive damage, destroys armor and debilitates enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness_tran: Channel your inner darkness to burn and blind nearby opponents.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.death_march_d: Gather your aura into a ring of devastating aura spheres that come crashing down.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.degenerate.de: Craft, decraft, customize items and absorb strength from weakened enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.demon_dominat: Dominate over any targets up to the Calamity level.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.demon_lord_ha: Unleash your Demonic aura causing those around you to quake in fear.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.demon_marione: Dominate over any targets even at the Disaster level.
Harden your aura around you to block incoming attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dimension_cut: Tear space to send forward a blade of dimension rift.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.divine_berser: Empower your body by a massive amount but beware the aftereffects.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.divine_ki_rel: Use your Divine Ki to amplify your battlewill to deal more damage and destroy weaker equipment.
Use percentages of the user's magical power to create identical clones around them.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_ear.de: Use your sensitive hearing to precisely pin the location of any nearby mobs which make sound.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_eye.de: Use your powerful sight to access the power of any entities and see in the far distance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_mode.d: Once a day, draw out your monstrous potential to double your EP and to boost your physical prowess. Doing this will leave a temporary toll on your body.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_skin.d: Transform your skin into scales which become tougher as you gain more EP.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.drain.descrip: Steal the vitality of your opponent and temporarily transform this skill into one of theirs to potentially turn the tables.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.drainage.desc: Drain the water around the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth.descrip: Place down blocks which mimic those from the surrounding environment.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_attack_: Ignore weak earth-based damage or resist the damage from powerful attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_dominat: Boosts the power of  Earth abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_jail.de: Restrict and weaken a single target, applying debuffs to allow you to finish them off.
